environment: Isolated KDE neon QEMU/KVM guest, headless virtio GPU, 1920x1080
desktop_capture: Spectacle inside the guest; QMP input targets only the guest; crops preserve original rendered pixels.
about: Shared preview_about.qml with canned hardware data and KDE platform theme; readiness signal checked before capture.
dock: Demo applications pinned in the guest; panel temporarily kept visible for capture, then returned to autohide.
boot: Shared tests/vm/render.sh in guest Xvfb; boot and shutdown pixel validations passed. Neon required plymouth.ignore-serial-consoles and an explicit temporary Theme setting. ImageMagick 6 uses a magick compatibility wrapper.
